# SheetJS Community Edition

- Version: 0.20.3
- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/
- Vendored file: `dist/xlsx.full.min.js`, renamed to `xlsx.cjs` for Node CommonJS.
- License: Apache-2.0; included in LICENSE.

The full build includes legacy XLS codepage support. Parsing runs in a bounded
worker, without macros, external links, shell commands, or cloud conversion copies.

SHA-256 of `xlsx.cjs`: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`.
